name: Lemon Candy
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Put into a kettle sugar, water, and cream tartar
Let boil until it becomes brittle when dropped into cold water
When sufficiently done take off fire and pour into a shallow dish which has been greased with a little butter
When this has been cooled so that it can be handled, add tartaric acid and extract of lemon
Work them into the mass until evenly distributed

source.originalInstructions:
1. Put into a kettle sugar, water, and cream tartar
2. Let boil until it becomes brittle when dropped into cold water
3. When sufficiently done take off fire and pour into a shallow dish which has been greased with a little butter
4. When this has been cooled so that it can be handled, add tartaric acid and extract of lemon
5. Work them into the mass until evenly distributed
